scope: frozen-code screening, one fresh three-peer LLM E2E per condition; not a robustness success-rate estimate
expected_limitation: Service-island variants can reject before transport because both passages are narrower than the supported pair formation. Such a result is not dynamic obstacle avoidance evidence.
success: fresh unanimous plan + both cargo lifted, fully inside requested dock slots, released and stable, weld OFF; independent evaluator output only
freeze: Commit configuration and destination option before all cases. Do not tune between cases. Save all failures.
controls: same seed/physical setup/models/contact profile/cameras; peer role, route and dependency choices are not preset; LLM variability can change multiple downstream choices
storage: Raw RGB/log/video local outputs only; summaries and hashes in Git; no Drive.
cost: Provider usage preserved; USD unavailable unless provider reports it.
